verdict.rationale: Twenty has no built-in firmographic or contact data provider. Enrichment is something you assemble yourself: workflows triggered on record changes can call external APIs through HTTP request or Code steps, and the docs explicitly list 'auto-enrich new contacts with data from external APIs' as a use case. AI agents are also documented to 'enrich records with data from external sources', but that still depends on outside data and on configuration by the user. Missing for 10: a native enrichment data source or integration, documented firmographic fields that populate automatically on companies, a step-by-step enrichment setup guide, and independent or hands-on confirmation that enrichment works.
